card.name: Words just before groups or parts
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs right before a noun for groups, parts, or divisions, such as 'divided into' or 'separated by'. It also fires where a split into sections or groups is about to be named.

modes.label: Dividing into parts
modes.description: A word like 'into', 'by', or 'separate' after a verb of dividing or splitting something.
modes.example: divided<< into>> parts of variable length, with each part

modes.label: Grouping perception
modes.description: Words leading into a description of seeing items as groups.
modes.example: there are 72 circles,<< but>> we perceive the collection of circles in groups

modes.label: List of unit types
modes.description: A linking word inside a list of puzzle regions such as column, row, and block.
modes.example: appears in every Column, Row,<< and>> Block of the completed puzzle

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like grouping, groups, partition, and subsets.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before the text names groups or parts that something is split into.
